Description: Urdu users get a "Get Urdu text" button on Sahih Muslim that can never work
Steps: Set app language Urdu > Hadith > Sahih Muslim > download > press Get Urdu text
Expected: Button hidden when the source has no Urdu for that book
Actual: urd-muslim file is 404 on jsDelivr; fetch error is swallowed; pack installs without ur; button stays
Root cause: hadithExtraLanguages assumes every book has ur and bn
Fix (proposed): Per-book language list (muslim: bn only) or hide button after a failed fetch
Regression test: Unit test: muslim + ur => no extra language offered
